bench.source: Artificial Analysis - Provider Voice Arena Leaderboard
bench.detail: Provider Voice leaderboard (Speech Arena Elo): Eleven v4 Turbo (eleven_v4_turbo) #1 of 98
Controlled Voice leaderboard (Elo): Eleven v4 Turbo #4 of 46
TTS latency leaderboard, sorted by time to first audio (TTFA): ElevenLabs Eleven v4 Turbo #12 of 28

vendorClaims.text: Eleven v4 / v4 Turbo released 2026-09-28; claims ~75% blind preference over Cartesia Sonic 3.6, Inworld TTS-2 and two Gemini TTS models in its own tests; v4 Turbo ~100 ms median inference, ~150 ms to first speech; 90+ languages; instant clones from ~10 s of audio.
Docs: eleven_v4 is the flagship highest-quality model; eleven_v4_turbo the flagship real-time model (~100 ms inference); Flash v2.5 ~75 ms; Turbo v2/v2.5 deprecated.

strengths: Top of Artificial Analysis blind-vote boards with v4 / v4 Turbo
Wide emotional range via audio tags (anger, whispers, shouts)
Strong voice cloning and large voice library
weaknesses: Misreads invented names; intense lines can break pronunciation
Credit-based pricing gets expensive; billing complaints on Trustpilot
Mid-pack on measured streaming latency (Coval #12 of 28)

bench.source: Artificial Analysis - Provider Voice Arena Leaderboard
bench.detail: Provider Voice leaderboard (Speech Arena Elo): Realtime TTS-2 (inworld-tts-2) #6 of 98
Controlled Voice leaderboard (Elo): Realtime TTS-2 #7 of 46
TTS latency leaderboard, sorted by TTFA: Realtime TTS-2 Flash (inworld-tts-2-flash) #2 of 28

vendorClaims.text: Realtime TTS-2 GA 2026-08-31 (preview 2026-05-05); 100+ languages, natural-language voice direction and inline [laugh]/[sigh] tags; sub-200 ms median time to first audio; 'Games and media' solution with Latitude testimonial.
Docs: TTS-2 is 'flagship, top-ranked' with 100 ms P90 server-side TTFB; TTS-2 Flash 20 ms P90; TTS-1/TTS-1 Max discontinued 2026-06-15; 1.5 Max/Mini deprecated.
Pricing per 1M characters: TTS-2 $25 on free On-Demand tier down to $12.50 on Growth (as low as $5 enterprise); Flash $15 down to $7.

strengths: Top-10 on both Artificial Analysis blind boards with TTS-2
TTS-2 Flash among the fastest measured (Coval 62 ms TTFA)
Cheaper per character than ElevenLabs list prices
weaknesses: Mid-table on the cloned-voice Humanness Index (#12 of 21)
Fast model churn: TTS-1 and 1.5 retired within a year
inworld-ai.note: Vapi's Humanness Index isn't counted for either tool: ElevenLabs' current model isn't on it, so it can't compare them fairly.

vendorClaims.text: Character voices come from third-party providers: Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, OpenAI and ElevenLabs. No default provider is named.
Pricing page lists an AI voice library and custom AI voice integration (PRO, $5 per 50,000 credits ~ 200 experience minutes) and premium AI voices (Enterprise). TTS provider not named.
Homepage: 'Text to speech' automation to 'speed up your video production with AI-generated voiceover files'; game customers named include tinyBuild, 11 bit studios, Hi-Rez, Game Science, Belka Games.

notes: Missing tools to consider: Cartesia (Sonic 3.6), Alibaba Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus, Google Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS, Fish Audio (Drama 3 / S2.1 Pro, open-weight S-series), Speechify Simba 3.2, Resemble AI / Chatterbox (MIT open source), Local runtime TTS: Kokoro, Piper, xVASynth
